color.note: A DevBrain theme over shadcn's neutral theme: same variable names, Tailwind v4 colours. Light is shadcn's light theme except the ring; dark keeps shadcn's values except where a usage note says DevBrain override. Status colours use the 700 step in light so they stay legible on white. Dark is the soft variant: a #111111 ground with the sidebar a step darker and cards a small step up, dimmer secondary text and 8% lines, so it is as subtle as light; status colours keep their 500 steps, which small glyphs need to read.

tokens.name: popover

tokens.name: popover-foreground

tokens.name: primary

tokens.name: primary-foreground

tokens.name: secondary

tokens.name: secondary-foreground

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: A segmented `ToggleGroup` or `Tabs` track: the page colour in dark; in light shadcn's muted track (neutral-100). Outlined with `border` in both themes.

tokens.name: segment-thumb
tokens.usage: The current segment: `secondary` (neutral-800) in dark, so it shows on a `card`; white in light, raised off the muted track by `shadow-segment`, as shadcn's.

tokens.name: segment-foreground
tokens.usage: A segmented control's unchosen items: `muted-foreground` in dark; `foreground` at 60% in light, as shadcn's Tabs.

tokens.name: capture-switch-track

tokens.name: capture-switch-border
tokens.usage: The capture box switch's outline: `border-strong` in dark, so it shows on the `card`; the segmented control's `border` in light.

tokens.name: capture-switch-thumb
tokens.usage: The capture box switch's current segment: `border-strong` in dark, as `secondary` barely differs from the `card` there; the segmented control's white thumb in light.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Group-heading band, all-day row, calendar event block, code (overrides shadcn's neutral-800).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, menu icons, descriptions. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-400; dimmer so it recedes as in light (5.1:1 dark on `card`, 4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Dates, issue keys, previews: metadata a reader can skip. DevBrain addition; 4.2:1 in dark on `card`, so never for instructions or errors.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard highlight on menu items, pickers and command results. neutral-800 in dark, as in shadcn: they sit on `popover` (neutral-900), so a neutral-900 highlight would not show. List rows hover with `row-selected` instead.

tokens.name: pill-fill
tokens.usage: Every entity pill's ground. Dark: none, so a pill is its outline on whatever it sits on and a card with several stays calm (it was `{neutral-950}`, the page colour, until Nov 2026, which set dark chips into cards). Light: white chips, which read on grey cards and on hovered ones, where the `border` outline matches the fill.

tokens.name: pill-fill-hover
tokens.usage: A pointed-at entity pill: `accent` at 60% in dark; `accent` (neutral-100) in light, so the tint shows on the white pill.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions: red text on a quiet button and in menus, never a red fill (6.0:1 on `popover` dark).

tokens.name: border
